correctness.rationale: The proof checks reflection Q_r(-n-1)=(-1)^r Q_r(n), reversed initial data from the p-1 recurrence, invertibility of (n+1)^r for 1<=n<=p-2, and the endpoint via c^(p-1)=1. The proof applies to all integer sequences satisfying the hypotheses, not just finite examples. Four independent binomial formulas and 4803 coefficients were checked by executable code.

value.rationale: This establishes the exact phenomenon Malik–Straub highlighted as empirical for four natural cubic sequences and strengthens it to twisted coefficient reciprocity, nonzero endpoint, an entire self-reciprocal polynomial identity and root pairing.
